name: Joker Chess
subtitle: Chess with a Twist
promotionalText: Chess with a twist: once per game, teleport a piece to any empty square. Free to play, no ads, no sign-up. Tap Play and you're in a game.
keywords: joker move,chess twist,chess variant,puzzles,chess bot,play chess,online chess,coach,friends
description:
We may have fixed chess.

One evening two friends got tired of seeing the same patterns on the board and tried one extra rule: once per game, each player may teleport a queen, rook, bishop or knight to any empty square. No capture, no check, just the piece landing where it is needed most. We played the rest of that visit on a wooden board and never went back. This app exists so we could keep playing after he flew home.

That one move is the Joker Move. One joker in your hand, once per game. While either player still holds it, every position stays tense: a rook can land behind your lines, a knight can appear next to your king, a bishop can close a diagonal at the last second. By our engine's count a Joker Move in hand is worth about 150 Elo, yet it rarely decides a game by itself. A beginner still won't beat a master. What changes is that no move is ever routine, and a lost position is still a game.

Everything else is the chess you know: castling, en passant, promotion. The first minute feels familiar. Every game after that doesn't.

PLAY
• Tap Play and you're in a rated 3+2 game. No sign-up: sign in later to keep your rating on any device.
• Bullet, blitz and rapid, with a Joker Chess rating of your own.
• Eight bots from 600 to 2500, each with its own style, from a park player to a machine.
• A friend with a 4-digit game code, or two players on one phone.

UNDERSTAND
• A full review after every game: accuracy, mistakes, blunders and the Joker Moves you missed, with what they would have done.
• A coach that explains each mistake with the line that punishes it, and shows the best line, Joker Moves included.
• Learn: 77 puzzles, easy to hard, where one Joker Move does it.

We wrote our own engine for the variant, because no existing one knows the Joker Move. Free to play, no ads, no sign-up to start. We built it in our free time, for chess and for friends.

Not another Chess960. The board and the openings are the ones you know; the game is not.

English and Russian.
whatsNew: New pieces in soft ivory and charcoal, same shapes you know. Play a friend with a 4-digit code. Learn opens straight on the puzzles, with clear right and wrong answers. Links to golden-chess.com open in the app. Calmer sounds, a centred board on iPad, and many small fixes.

review.notes:
Joker Chess (formerly Golden Chess) is a chess variant: regular chess plus one "Joker Move" per player per game (teleport a queen, rook, bishop or knight to any empty square; no capture, no check).

Most of the app works without an account: tap Play → Bots and play any bot; Play → Two players for a local game; Learn for the rule and puzzles. Online rated games and the game history need an account.

DEMO ACCOUNT: sign in with the e-mail and password given above (Profile → Sign in → enter the demo e-mail → a password field appears; everyone else gets a 6-digit code by e-mail). With an account you can also play a rated game online and open the review of any finished game (Profile → History → Start review); a game against a bot shows the same review without an account.

Sign-in options in this build: Sign in with Apple, Google, e-mail (6-digit code) and e-mail + password.

The app shows the live web app (golden-chess.com) in a native shell; the chess engine runs on the device.
